text.p: Honeywell Inc said Thursday orders for the fourth quarter were up 13 percent.
Earlier, Honeywell reported earnings of $1.21 a share for the fourth quarter, up from $0.99 a year ago.
Operating profit in the quarter was $271.5 million, up from $233.7 million for the same period last year. Sales in the period were $2.12 billion, compared with $1.92 billion a year ago.

Honeywell said its home and building control operating profit rose to $145.5 million in the fourth quarter, compared with $123.7 million in the 1995 period. Sales for the business during the quarter were $999 million, up from $898 million a year ago, and orders gained nine percent.
Industrial control operating profit for the quarter was $86.7 million, compared to $80.7 million a year earlier. Sales rose to $631 million from $595 million last year, and orders gained 22 percent.

Space and aviation control operating profit for the quarter was $39.9 million compared with $32.4 million for the same period in 1995. Sales were $441 million, up from $384 million a year earlier, and orders increased 17 percent.
